data_description.host: IP address or host name of the SAJ AS1 Modbus TCP endpoint (for example the AIO3 stick).

connection_unavailable.title: {name} has been unreachable for {minutes} minutes
connection_unavailable.description:
Home Assistant has not been able to read the SAJ AS1 inverter at {host}:{port} for {minutes} minutes. Its sensors stay unavailable and battery settings cannot be changed until the connection is back.

1. Check that the AIO3 stick (or Modbus TCP gateway) is powered and connected to your network, for example in the SAJ app or your router.
2. Make sure no other Modbus client is polling the stick at the same time.
3. If the address of the stick changed, open the SAJ AS1 Modbus integration and choose **Reconfigure** to enter the new address.
4. If the stick does not answer at all, power cycle the inverter or the stick.

This message disappears automatically once the inverter answers again.
